'''Ravin Zael''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] before defecting to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Zael was transported aboard the convoy known as [[Perlemian Haul]] after his defection.<ref name="PH" />
